title: vLLM-Omni runs MiniMax H3-Image on Rubin, with 4K in 0.87 seconds
summary: vLLM-Omni now serves MiniMax H3-Image, ranked first among open-weight image-editing models by Artificial Analysis, on NVIDIA Vera Rubin with native 4K generation in 0.87 seconds. Early tuning on 4 Rubin GPUs measured 6,115 images per hour. The same model path also runs on NVIDIA data-center and RTX GPUs, AMD, Intel, Moore Threads, and Huawei Ascend NPUs.
